card.title: Take My Side
card.instruction: Recruit someone into your interpretation of a conflict involving a shared relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When Mum mentions the holiday argument, remind her I offered to drive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can build toward that detail.

beats.text: Start at the helpful bit so the rest has context.

mechanism: A recruits a family member to frame a holiday argument around A's helpfulness before admitting the mistake.
confusable: Unlike merely telling a preferred story, A must enlist another person to carry that interpretation to a shared relation.
comparison: D79-a bargains over story order to Mum; D79-b bargains over the meaning of an admitted rota change to Alex.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
